transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... well, it's mostly physical stuff, I guess. I just... my shoulders and neck are always so tense. It's like I'm constantly braced for something, you know? Like a classroom observation that just keeps going. And... by the time I get home, my jaw aches so much I can't even play my guitar. It just won't let up.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried a lot of the time, even when there's no clear reason for it?

I... I suppose so. It's hard to explain. My mind just kind of... keeps circling, I guess. 

Mostly about work. I'll just get stuck wondering if I'll ever get hired again, or... if I've somehow ruined my reputation with the parents. It just spirals into worrying about retirement slipping away. Sometimes it's over nothing, really. Like... even if I just make a small mistake during a story-time activity, I'll start thinking maybe I shouldn't even be trusted with the children anymore. 

It's... yeah. Just a lot of that.
Have you noticed these physical symptoms, like the tension in your neck and shoulders or the jaw pain, happening even when you're not stressed or thinking about work?
I... I don't really know. I haven't paid that much attention to when it happens. It just... it just hurts a lot of the time. I guess I'm always thinking about work, so... it's hard to separate it.
Have you noticed the tension in your neck, shoulders, or jaw ever happening when your mind isn't focused on work or worries?
I... I'm not really sure. I don't think I ever really stop thinking about it, to be honest. It just always feels tense.
Can you recall any specific times when your neck, shoulders, or jaw felt tense even when you weren’t thinking about work or feeling worried about anything?
I don't... I don't really know. Like I said, it's just sort of... always there. I can't really pinpoint a specific time.
Have you noticed any days or moments when your neck, shoulders, or jaw didn’t feel tense, even briefly?

No... not really. That's... that's actually why I finally made this appointment. My shoulders and neck, they just... they stay clenched all day. It's like I'm constantly bracing for a classroom observation, but it never stops. And... by the time I get home, my jaw aches so much I can't even enjoy playing my guitar anymore. It just doesn't go away.
Have you ever experienced any other physical symptoms, like headaches, stomach issues, or dizziness, that also don’t seem to go away even when you’re not thinking about work or feeling anxious?
No... I don't think so. Just the muscle stuff I mentioned.
Have you noticed any other physical symptoms — like fatigue, shortness of breath, or tingling sensations — that you can’t explain and that don’t seem connected to your anxiety or work-related stress?
No, I... I haven't noticed anything like that. Just the tension I told you about.
Have you seen a doctor or had any medical tests to check if there’s a physical cause for the tension in your neck, shoulders, or jaw?
No, I haven't. I just... I came here.
Can you confirm if your neck, shoulders, or jaw ever feel tense even when you’re not feeling stressed or anxious about anything?
I... I don't really know. It's just sort of always there. I don't think there's really a time when I'm not feeling stressed about something, so... it's hard to tell.
Can you think of any time — even when you were relaxed or enjoying something — when your neck, shoulders, or jaw still felt tense, even if you weren't stressed or worried about anything?
I... I really can't think of a time like that. Like I said, I'm just... always kind of worried about something. So, no, I don't think so.
